title: Aplicación - API backend
description: Latencia, peticiones por segundo, errores por endpoint y códigos HTTP (logs del backend y métricas OpenTelemetry)

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL
SELECT approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.95) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, COUNT(*) / 60.0 AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.5) AS y_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.95) AS y_axis_2, approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.99) AS y_axis_3 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, concat(method, ' ', route) AS breakdown_1, approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.95) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, CAST(statuscode AS VARCHAR) AS breakdown_1, COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Tasa de error en el tiempo (%)

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS y_axis_1, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 400 AND statuscode < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS y_axis_2 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT CAST(statuscode AS VARCHAR) AS x_axis_1, COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT method, route, COUNT(*) AS peticiones, SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 400 AND statuscode < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores_4xx, SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores_5xx, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN statuscode >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_error, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(durationms, 0.95), 1) AS p95_ms FROM "default" WHERE statuscode IS NOT NULL AND route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY method, route ORDER BY errores_5xx DESC, errores_4xx DESC
